title: botrychium lunaria var. typicum
intro: Botrychium lunaria var. typicum, commonly known as American moonwort, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Ophioglossaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of American moonwort include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of American moonwort include reducing inflammation, improving skin health, and boosting the immune system, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
